```python
    s = w[EU] + w[EV]
    c = np.where(s <= 0.0, BIG, 1.0 / np.maximum(s, 1e-12))
    L = np.zeros((NTOT, NTOT))
    np.add.at(L, (EU, EU), c)
    np.add.at(L, (EV, EV), c)
    np.add.at(L, (EU, EV), -c)
    np.add.at(L, (EV, EU), -c)
    ws = w[bsrc]
    cs = np.where(ws <= 0.0, BIG, 1.0/np.maximum(ws,1e-12))
    np.add.at(L, (bsrc, bsrc), cs)
    L[SRC, SRC] += cs.sum()
    np.add.at(L, (bsrc, SRC), -cs)
    np.add.at(L, (SRC, bsrc), -cs)
    wd = w[bdst]
    cd = np.where(wd <= 0.0, BIG, 1.0/np.maximum(wd,1e-12))
    np.add.at(L, (bdst, bdst), cd)
    L[DST, DST] += cd.sum()
    np.add.at(L, (bdst, DST), -cd)
    np.add.at(L, (DST, bdst), -cd)
    # solve with DST grounded
    keep = np.arange(NTOT-1)  # 0..121, drop DST(122)
    A = L[np.ix_(keep, keep)]
    I = np.zeros(NTOT-1)
    I[SRC] = 1.0
    try:
        V = np.linalg.solve(A, I)
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
        return 1e9
    return V[SRC]
```

```python
def _resistance(w, bsrc, bdst):
    s = w[_EU] + w[_EV]
    c = np.where(s <= 0.0, BIG, 1.0 / np.maximum(s, 1e-12))
    L = np.zeros((NT, NT))
    np.add.at(L, (_EU, _EU), c)
    np.add.at(L, (_EV, _EV), c)
    np.add.at(L, (_EU, _EV), -c)
    np.add.at(L, (_EV, _EU), -c)
    ws = w[bsrc]
    cs = np.where(ws <= 0.0, BIG, 1.0 / np.maximum(ws, 1e-12))
    np.add.at(L, (bsrc, bsrc), cs)
    np.add.at(L, (bsrc, SRC), -cs)
    np.add.at(L, (SRC, bsrc), -cs)
    L[SRC, SRC] += cs.sum()
    wd = w[bdst]
    cd = np.where(wd <= 0.0, BIG, 1.0 / np.maximum(wd, 1e-12))
    np.add.at(L, (bdst, bdst), cd)
    np.add.at(L, (bdst, DST), -cd)
    np.add.at(L, (DST, bdst), -cd)
    L[DST, DST] += cd.sum()
    A = L[:DST, :DST]  # drop DST row/col (ground it)
    I = np.zeros(DST)
    I[SRC] = 1.0
    try:
        V = np.linalg.solve(A, I)
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
        return 1e9
    r = V[SRC]
    return r
```
